title: Hearing on residential fires caused by lithium-ion batteries
summary: The Council's Fire and Emergency Management and Housing and Buildings committees held an oversight hearing on residential fires linked to lithium-ion batteries, alongside several related bills on battery storage, retailer penalties and inspection plans. Documents show the city had 400 lithium-ion battery fires by November 2026, up from 292 in all of 2025, with injuries rising to 83 and deaths to 12 this year. Testimony was expected from FDNY, the Department of Buildings, HPD, labor and business groups, and delivery workers.
